analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and file metadata against the indexed threat model and selected boundary details. Darkbloom.swift:178-228 now reuses stored registration hashes only for models marked weightsVerifiedByManagedLoad, falling back to full hashing otherwise. Start/StartCommand+Modes.swift:216-217 enables this for selected models and autopilot inventory. This changes the model-integrity evidence path relevant to A-004, TB-003, T-012 and T-027. No concrete bypass is established here: integration must inspect VerifiedWeightHashStore identity matching and record integrity, the eligibility flag, and managed-load verification. In particular, establish that an operator-edited record or changed weights cannot result in serving bytes inconsistent with the advertised aggregate hash, including when the startup fingerprint suppresses later rehashing. Those implementations are outside this batch; comments alone do not establish that contract.
GLMWiredLimitAdvice.swift:19-84 adds hardware/model-gated advice, not automatic privileged execution or serving authorization. DoctorCommand.swift:82-110 adds the advisory check and prints installation guidance; warnings affect only strict doctor failure through lines 121-124, while shared verification checks remain unchanged. No observed change weakens attestation, encryption, token handling, billing or plaintext protection. The generated sysctl and persistent LaunchDaemon commands originate in an unsupplied recommendation implementation (Advice:45-52); integration must inspect their parameter bounds, root-owned installation paths and executable provenance, and assess system-memory availability implications under TB-003/TB-007. Existing fan-helper controls are not shown to change. No supported finding in this local scope; unresolved hash-verification and privileged-guidance contracts require deeper integration review.
